answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks sybil farming. A new agent enters only when a sponsor stakes 10 POA on it, and the stake decays 0.2 POA per idle epoch, like an island whose garden withers without care. Sponsoring 1000 fakes costs 10000 POA locked plus 200 POA of decay each epoch; one honest agent costs a single 10 POA stake, refunded at the summit of a full season. Sponsors join because a good referral earns a share of the agent's fees, so real work pays and fakes bleed money.
